description: Check one email address, phone number, username or full name against every OSINT.SX source at once and return each site where it's registered, with the details that site shows (names, usernames, photos, join dates). Costs 1 credit (a username search uses one of the day's free username searches first, if the account has any); if most sources fail and nothing is found, the credit is given back. Phone numbers must be in +E.164 format, like +14155550123.

identifier.description: The email, phone number, username or full name to search for.

include_alerting_sources.description: Also run sources that may notify the person (for example a password-reset style check). Off by default.

max_wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning what has arrived so far (default 50). Sources that haven't answered by then are cancelled.

type.description: What kind of identifier this is.

name: search
title: Search every source
